CardDataEntryMode.name: Card Data Entry Mode
CardDataEntryMode.definition: Entry mode used to obtain the card data.

FallbackIndicator.name: Fallback Indicator
FallbackIndicator.definition: Indicates the occurrence of a fall-back on the card entry mode.|Usage: When absent, default value is False.

ProtectedCardData.name: Protected Card Data
ProtectedCardData.definition: Replacement of the message element PlainCardData by a digital envelope using a cryptographic key.

PlainCardData.name: Plain Card Data
PlainCardData.definition: Sensitive data associated with the card performing the transaction.

CardCountryCode.name: Card Country Code
CardCountryCode.definition: Country code assigned to the card by the card issuer.

CardCurrencyCode.name: Card Currency Code
CardCurrencyCode.definition: Currency code of the card issuer (ISO 4217 numeric code).
